question: Which customers are from India?
sql: SELECT customer_id, name FROM customers WHERE country = 'India'

question: What is the average product price?
sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_price FROM products

question: Which products cost more than 100 dollars?
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100

question: How many orders has each customer placed?
sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id

question: Which customers have spent more than 500 dollars?
sql: SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) > 500

question: Which products have never been ordered?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.product_id IS NULL
